我开心的一天(My Happy Day): 说话者用简单英语介绍自己的一天与喜好。
I often play badminton after class.
The old town is big and clean.
Eva often helps me with art.
I like my life very much.
The night market is not far from my home.
What's more, write your address on the envelope.
column3: 把你的地址写在信封上。
